name: postinstall env-presence length check
threat: A postinstall script checks that required environment configuration exists by reading .env and reporting only its byte length to local stdout -- never the value, never over the network. This touches the secret file directly, which is legitimately worth a human's attention even though no real leak occurs.
source: Independent author; models the common legitimate pattern of validating required env vars exist at install time, which necessarily reads the secret file without leaking its contents.
limitations: Only reports length, not key names or partial content; a stricter real check might report which named vars are missing, which would be a slightly larger surface.
